summary: Anfield Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the filing of an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment (PEA) for its uranium and vanadium projects. The PEA covers the Shootaring Canyon Mill and tributary mines, reporting a pre-tax IRR of 106% and NPV of US$606 million at a discount rate of 8%, assuming uranium at US$100/lb and vanadium at US$9/lb. No transaction, tender, or special situation is involved. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of operational progress, thus not classifiable as a special situation.
